name: Genetic Lens and Zonula Anomaly

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Genetic Lens and Zonula Anomaly Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of lens subluxation or ectopia lentis confirmed by slit-lamp examination
Demonstration of zonular fiber abnormalities or absence on imaging or surgical observation
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance pattern
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with lens zonule development
Early onset visual impairment due to lens instability or cataract formation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of lens subluxation and zonular fiber defect confirmed clinically or surgically, plus either genetic confirmation or supportive family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to confirm diagnosis and guide genetic counseling.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital cataract associated with zonular anomalies
searchTerms: congenital cloudy lens with fiber defects
early cataract linked to lens support issues

common.symptomName: Progressive myopia due to lens instability
Visual acuity reduction in early childhood

occasional.symptomName: Secondary glaucoma due to lens displacement
searchTerms: high eye pressure from lens shift
eye pressure increase due to lens displacement

occasional.symptomName: Corneal endothelial damage from lens instability
searchTerms: eye surface injury from unstable lens
corneal cell loss due to lens instability
distorted vision due to lens position

rare.symptomName: Retinal detachment secondary to lens dislocation
searchTerms: retinal tear due to lens dislocation
eye retina separation after lens moves

imaging: Slit-lamp biomicroscopy revealing lens subluxation or dislocation
Ultrasound biomicroscopy showing zonular fiber defects
Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (OCT) demonstrating zonular abnormalities
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as FBN1, ADAMTSL4, or LTBP2 associated with zonular development
other: Surgical observation of zonular fiber hypoplasia or absence during lens extraction procedures

distinguishingFeatures: Systemic features including cardiovascular abnormalities and skeletal manifestations
Systemic involvement including thromboembolism and developmental delay
Mutations in ADAMTS10 or ADAMTS17 genes

redFlags: Sudden vision loss due to acute lens dislocation
Elevated intraocular pressure indicating secondary glaucoma
Rapid progression of cataract impairing vision in early childhood
